title: Density relation for ball floating at interface of two immiscible liquids

extraction_metadata.source_note: Source text prints 'true for rho_1, rho_1 and rho_3' but contextually means 'rho_1, rho_2 and rho_3'. Transcribed as visually present per Zero Pre-Verification rule.

question.statement: A jar is filled with two non-mixing liquids 1 and 2 having densities $\rho_{1}$ and, $\rho_{2}$ respectively. A solid ball, made of a material of density $\rho_{3}$, is dropped in the jar. It comes to equilibrium in the position shown in the figure. Which of the following is true for $\rho_{1}$, $\rho_{1}$ and $\rho_{3}$?

figure_refs.caption: Jar with two non-mixing liquid layers: Liquid 1 (density $\rho_1$) on top and Liquid 2 (density $\rho_2$) on bottom, with a solid ball of density $\rho_3$ in equilibrium at the interface.
figure_refs.alt_text: Cross-section of a rectangular jar containing two immiscible liquid layers. The upper layer is labeled 'Liquid 1: rho_1' and the lower layer is labeled 'Liquid 2: rho_2'. A shaded spherical ball is shown floating at the boundary between the two liquids, partially submerged in each.
